content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD ship-wake (vessel) module, entire file guarded by '# if defined (VESSEL)' (L53, closed L960; header L46, history 10/07/2016 Fengyan Shi L49; L3 header comment says 'FILE vessle.F' - typo). MODULE VESSEL_MODULE (L55) supports three moving-vessel source types selected per vessel by SourceType: 'PR' pressure source, 'SL' slender-body flux source, 'PA' Green-function flux source, with optional DEEP_DRAFT_VESSEL and PROPELLER preprocessor extensions. VESSEL_INITIAL (L122-456): reads VESSEL_FOLDER (L142), NumVessel (L149), OUT_VESSEL (L156) from input.txt; DEEP_DRAFT_VESSEL reads MaskMethod (L163, default .TRUE.), CLEARANCE (L178, default 1.0), FrictionMethod (L194, default .TRUE.) with CdDeepDraft (L209, default 0.1), ViscosityMethod (L227, default .FALSE.) with VisDeepDraft (L242, default 0.1); allocates per-vessel and 2D arrays (L263-298); reads PLOT_INTV_VESSEL (L302, default SMALL L309); then per vessel Kves opens VESSEL_FOLDER//'vessel_NNNNN' (5-digit name built L315-326) on unit 2000+Kves (L344-345; missing file STOP L336/L339), reads name, SourceType/VesselType (L348-349), geometry LengthVessel/WidthVessel/AlphaVessel1/AlphaVessel2/BetaVessel/Pvessel for 'PR' (L353-355) or 'SL' (L384-386), PROPELLER parameters N_revolution/D_prop/C_thrust/D_hub/BAR/H_prop/C_duct (L358-359), first track point Time/X/Y (L390), copies level 2 to 1 (L392-394); Type-1 clamps Alpha1/Beta into [SMALL,1] (L374-379; commented Type-2 protection L366-372, comment L363-364 'for type 2 divid and volker 2017, alpha1 is cl,alpha2 is cb, beta is a'); logs all parameters (L400-420); PROPELLER derives E0=(D_prop/D_hub)**(-0.403)*C_thrust**(-1.79)*BAR**0.744 (L446-447), Veff=E0*N*D*sqrt(Ct) (L448), Cf=0.01*(D_prop/H_prop) (L449), IZEF=D_prop/2/C_duct (L450). VESSEL_FORCING (L458-634): zeroes accumulators (L465-471); per vessel advances the track when TIME passes both bracket times using DO WHILE(TimeVessel2<TIME+DT) reads with END=120 (L484-486; comment L483 dated 08/05/2019), heading ThetaVessel=ATAN2(dY,dX) (L498-499), panel-source velocity Uvel/Vvel=dX/dT,dY/dT (L503-506); linear time interpolation weights (L521-523) give vessel position Xves/Yves (L527-528); dispatches PRESSURE_SOURCE (L534) accumulating VesselPressureTotal (and propeller Up/Vp/Upc totals L538-540), SLENDER_BODY_SOURCE (L547) or GREEN_FUNCTION_SOURCE (L554) accumulating VesselFluxGradient; label 120 @L560 per-vessel EOF; then pressure gradient forcing VesselPressureX=-Grav*H*d(VesselPressureTotal)/dx central difference (L581-586; comment L579 sign fix 11/22/2016); DEEP_DRAFT_VESSEL marks a +-Nghost neighborhood with MaskVessel=0/CdVessel_2D/VisVessel_2D where draft is within CLEARANCE of the bottom (L590-606); one-time initial draft sets Eta=-VesselPressureTotal (L613-623, comment L612 dated 09/12/2018); PARALLEL+PROPELLER ghost-exchanges UpcTotal via PHI_COLL (L628-629). PRESSURE_SOURCE (L636-796): in ship-fixed coordinates Lves/Wves (rotation L667-668) inside the LengthVessel x WidthVessel rectangle applies Ertekin et al. JFM 1986 (comment L675) Type-1 cosine-squared tapered pressure P_x (bow/stern tapers L685-698) and P_y (side taper L700-706) with VesselPressureEach=Pvessel*P_x*P_y (L708), or Type-2 polynomial-exponential hull (L713-716); PROPELLER computes propeller-race velocity UUp behind the stern (near/far field split at IZEF, L723-733) giving Up/Vp/Upc (L734-736); wave-making resistance integrated over interior cells only (comment L742-744 credits Jeff Harris for ghost-cell double-count fix) as +-eta-slope-split components ResPosX/ResNegX/ResPosY/ResNegY=sum(P*rho*g*deta*ds) (L749-773), MPI_ALLREDUCE-summed (L781-792). GREEN_FUNCTION_SOURCE (L798-885): under REALISTIC_VESSEL_BODY an image-source Green-function Gz series with m_trunc=5 (L808-857); otherwise a slender sine/cosine-squared flux-gradient shape VesselFluxGradientEach=Pvessel*SIN(2*PI*Lves/L)*COS(PI*Wves/W)**2 (L873-875). SLENDER_BODY_SOURCE (L888-956): Tanimoto et al. 2000 (comment L899) Type-1 same sine/cos**2 shape (L911-913); Type-2 splits the hull into bow/stern taper zones x_right_1/2, x_left_1/2 (L918-921) with sine flux in the tapers (L926-934) and ZERO midship (L938).

verbatim_spans.text: !  VESSEL is a module to model ship-wakes
!                for type 2 divid and volker 2017, alpha1 is cl,alpha2 is cb
! I add while to avoid dt is smaller than the time interval of vessel path 08/05/2019
! because of including ghost cells (thanks to Jeff Harris)
! initial parabolic function by Tanimoto et al. 2000

unresolved: REALISTIC_VESSEL_BODY branch of GREEN_FUNCTION_SOURCE cannot compile as written: declarations @L809-812 appear after the executable statement @L806; @L835 has unbalanced parentheses '+ V(I,J+1)-V(I,J-1))/DY*0.5_SP)'; @L837/L842/L844 index 1D arrays Xco/Yco as Xco(I,J)/Yco(I,J); @L851-852 lacks an operator between '(Uvel(Kves)-U(I,J))/DX' and the next term - dead code unless the macro is never enabled

Cross-line: W_farfield @L831-835 is assigned as a whole-array expression using scalar-indexed right-hand side inside the (I,J) loop, and Z_prime(I,J)=Pvessel(Kves) @L830 treats the draft as depth of the source point; far-field condition @L827-828 uses .AND. so points beside the hull (only one coordinate outside) are neither near- nor far-field
VESSEL_FORCING pressure-gradient loop @L576-586 divides by scalar DX/DY only - no non-CARTESIAN (spherical) variant, unlike other modules with DX(I,J) branches

Type-1 taper condition @L685-686 'Lves>0.5*L*Alpha1' vs midship @L695-696 'Lves<=0.5*L*Alpha1' overlap consistently, but if AlphaVessel1=1 (clamped max) the taper zone is empty and P_x=1 across the half-length; commented-out Type-2 parameter protection @L366-372 acknowledged as removed
Shared label 120 @L560 is inside the Kves loop (per-vessel EOF skips only that vessel's source accumulation for the step) - unlike mod_tide.F where one EOF skips all remaining boundaries
MakeVesselDraft initial draft @L613-623 sets Eta=-VesselPressureTotal only where |P|>SMALL on the first VESSEL_FORCING call for all source types even though only 'PR' fills VesselPressureTotal
OUT_VESSEL and PLOT_INTV_VESSEL/PLOT_COUNT_VESSEL are read/initialized here but no vessel output writing exists in this file; ResistanceX/Y computed and reduced but not output here

DEEP_DRAFT_VESSEL neighborhood loops @L592-593 run II=I-Nghost..I+Nghost without bounds clamping - at interior edges II/JJ index ghost cells legally, but MaskVessel edits are not ghost-exchanged in this file
Vessel file name supports up to 5 digits (L315-324) but writes leading zeros digit-by-digit; FILE_VESSEL remains 5 chars of a longer 80-char blank string

GREEN_FUNCTION_SOURCE non-realistic branch is identical in shape to SLENDER_BODY_SOURCE Type-1 (compare L873-875 and L911-913); Gz allocated @L275-276 and zeroed @L288 but only used in the broken REALISTIC_VESSEL_BODY branch
ierr declared in PRESSURE_SOURCE/GREEN_FUNCTION_SOURCE/SLENDER_BODY_SOURCE (L640,L802,L892) but unused; dummy names Xves,Yves shadow module variables @L86
